text: {"lessons":["Selling winners in pieces has felt rewarding, but I should not let the satisfaction of locking in gains override a reasoned view of each stock’s prospects.","Selling Stock E at a large loss was painful; I should assess whether the investment thesis has changed rather than hold or sell solely to avoid realizing a loss.","After buying more Stock A, I should keep position size and portfolio risk in view, not judge each stock only by its own gain or loss versus my cost."]}
